feedback: Reviewed before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. It changes one value from the best raced design (iteration 3, score 326.7): controller.kp 2.0 to 1.7, with kd 0.5, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.2, line_loss last_direction and all geometry and sensor_weights unchanged. The contract fields are all within range. The evidence supports a single-variable test of gain direction. In iteration 3, kd 0.5 cut oval line loss to 0.55 and produced 11 of 20 finishes, but the s-bend and slalom still lost the line about once per run (1.1 and 1.0) with max_error of 0.063 and 0.071. In iteration 2, raising kp to 2.5 made slalom line loss worse (1.0 to 1.85) and reduced oval progress (0.70 to 0.57), so a lower kp is the direction most likely to help the s-bend and slalom. The main risk, from the same evidence, is that kp 1.7 under-corrects the tight oval bends and loses finishes. The rationale's own condition for this step is only partly met, because slalom max_error is above 0.06, but this is a cheap, informative test against the best design, so it is worth racing. Read the next race as follows. If oval finishes and progress hold (progress about 0.9 or more) and s-bend or slalom line_loss_events fall toward 1.0 or below, keep kp 1.7 and then test base_speed 1.4 for the speed limit. If oval finishes or progress fall clearly, revert kp to 2.0, which is the best raced value, and do not lower kp further. If line loss rises on any track, the correction is not the limit at this kd, so return to kp 2.0 and examine kd or line_loss next.
requested_changes: If oval progress stays about 0.9 or higher and s-bend or slalom line_loss_events fall toward 1.0 or below with kd 0.5 kept, keep controller.kp 1.7 and test controller.base_speed 1.4 as the next single change, since iteration 2 showed speed is the next limit once line loss is controlled.

If oval finishes or progress fall clearly below the iteration 3 values (0.55 finishes, progress 0.94), revert controller.kp to 2.0 with kd 0.5, because iteration 2 showed that moving kp away from 2.0 in either direction hurt the oval.

If line_loss_events rise on the slalom or s-bend at kp 1.7, do not lower kp further; keep kp 2.0 and test controller.kd 0.6 or 0.7 with steering_oscillation as the guard, since iteration 3 kept oscillation below 0.4 at kd 0.5.
